{{Top|leg}}
The '''Alliance Survey Team Theta''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] survey group during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The team recovered the personal logs of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jonox Forb]] from a [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] cave on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
